claims.label: Cinorf10-associated reduced susceptibility to duramycin
claims.note: Both compared subjects are laboratory derivatives of the 1326 background, including a vector control. Protection varies with expression context; gene presence alone did not predict protection across the tested contexts. NCBITaxon:1200984 denotes the background, not either derivative. UniProtKB:Q83VX7 is reference-only: its source strain DSM 40005 differs from the study's DSM 40646 donor. Source-reported duramycin maps to the existing ChEBI exact synonym of lancovutide; this is not direct cinnamycin AST. No clinical category, numerical AST or exact allele is assigned.

claims.label: cinorf10/CinKR contribution to native-host duramycin protection
claims.note: Separate laboratory derivatives of the reported DSM 40646 background provide loss-of-protection evidence, not resistant alterations or individual gene sufficiency. UniProtKB:Q83VX7, UniProtKB:Q83VX8 and UniProtKB:Q83VX9 remain reference candidates with different strain context; no derivative TaxID or genome is assigned. Source-reported duramycin maps to the existing ChEBI exact synonym of lancovutide; this is not direct cinnamycin AST. No clinical category, numerical AST or exact allele is assigned.
